Find:
1. The dashboard page/component and how it links to project pages

3. Any existing loading/prefetch patterns in the codebase
4. Relevant docs in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ about prefetching, loading UI, and navigation

Return file paths, key code snippets, and recommendations for the most idiomatic way to achieve instant title display without prefetching the full project page. Do not write code yet, just research.
